title: Map boss rush with Overseer tablets
summary: Make more Map Bosses Powerful and more rare packs into bosses, then stack Map Boss rarity, quantity and waystone mods from Overseer tablets and the atlas tree.

budget.build_needs: Kills Powerful Map Bosses quickly in T15–T16 maps.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from what the setup needs; not measured.

yields.why: Pathkeepers and the 'of Pathways' Overseer mod raise waystone drops from Map Bosses.
Same sources as Tier 16; keeps the map loop sustained.

nodes.name: Mighty Prey
nodes.effect: 25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses

nodes.name: Ancient Inscriptions
nodes.effect: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

nodes.name: Patient Battue
nodes.effect: 25% chance 1 Rare Monster is replaced by a random Map Boss; 5% chance 3 additional Rare Monsters are replaced by a random Map Boss

atlas_master.alt: Jado T1 In The Wrong Hands: Powerful Map Bosses drop an additional unique item.

claim.note: Our synthesis from the node texts: more (and more Powerful) Map Bosses per map. Not measured. T2 is a free pick: no Hilda T2 node adds boss loot (Soul Eaters only makes Map Bosses stronger).

atlas_passives.name: Fit for a King
atlas_passives.effect: 20% increased Rarity of Items dropped by Map Bosses

atlas_passives.name: Hard-Won Treasures
atlas_passives.effect: 15% increased Quantity of Items dropped by Map Bosses (requires completing the Matriarch Halls)

atlas_passives.name: Pathkeepers
atlas_passives.effect: 15% increased Quantity of Waystones dropped by Map Bosses

atlas_passives.name: Eons of Domination
atlas_passives.effect: Overseer Precursor Tablets can drop from Powerful Map Bosses

atlas_passives.name: Valuable Paths
atlas_passives.effect: 50% increased Rarity of Waystones found; 10% increased Quantity of Waystones dropped by Map Bosses

mods.text: (35–60)% increased Rarity of Items dropped by Map Bosses
(13–20)% increased Quantity of Items dropped by Map Bosses
(18–30)% increased Quantity of Waystones dropped by Map Bosses
Map Bosses have an additional Modifier

waystone.notes: Item rarity first; waystone drop chance keeps the loop going.

claim.note: Editorial. poe2db does not say whether the map's item rarity total adds to what the Map Boss drops.

steps: Allocate Fit for a King, Hard-Won Treasures, Pathkeepers and Eons of Domination.
Set Hilda: Mighty Prey, Ancient Inscriptions, Patient Battue; T2 is a free pick.
Slot an Overseer Tablet with Map Boss rarity ('of Treasure') first, quantity ('of Hoards') second.
Rush to the boss; keep Overseer tablets that Powerful Map Bosses drop for the next maps.
risks: Cruel Hegemony makes every Map Boss harder (one more modifier) with no stated reward.
Map Boss loot beyond waystones is random; the basket prices only the waystones.
